additional_info.subject: ID0444512-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP/R7 170002206] multiple non-successful transactions. CRM:02889000450
additional_info.body:
Hi Milan, good afternoon :) Ready for the weekend?
Coap polling error is due to a poor strength in the communication between SECC and PLC. In the new v8.0.5, this is mitigated.
My recommendation is to update to v8.0.5 and if the error happens again, then we need to check first Ethernet cable of the EcoG and if it's the same, replace the EcoG.
I started the rollout of FW8.0.5, please install it as soon as it's ready and no one is charging.
I will close the ticket since solution has been provided.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
